# lab-edge services (ADR 0068 step 6, build step 3): netmiko for the router sessions, installed with --require-hashes.
# 4.7.0 rather than 4.8.0 (out 2026-09-21): a release gets a few months in the wild before the key-holding runner runs it.
# R7 (ADR 0076): pybatfish 2025.7.7.2423 for batfish-check, the questions Hand Off asks Batfish before its card; it brings
# pandas and numpy (about 210 MB more in the image). Compiled together with netmiko so one resolution holds, and constrained
# to requirements-terraform-run.txt so the two files agree; the three packages both need (python-dateutil, six, urllib3)
# are listed there only (installed first), which keeps the two files disjoint. Dependencies are the newest up to the
# compile cutoff (2026-09-15, the first that admits urllib3 2.8.0 from the other file).
# Regenerate: printf 'netmiko==<ver>\npybatfish==<ver>\n' | uv pip compile - -c requirements-terraform-run.txt \
#   --python-version 3.12 --python-platform x86_64-manylinux_2_28 --only-binary :all: --generate-hashes \
#   --exclude-newer <a date a month or more back> --no-header --no-annotate, then drop the three packages above.
